currentWork.title: FINAL.29 dedicated tollways extra — production released and verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.29 is live. PR #156 merged to main at e24d82fc10a53614493e041cdba29715b303963e. Vercel production deployment dpl_6PyUsLB4QQEnyfjWkWG5kRu3VTqv is READY. Main browser regression run 37500262557 and GitHub Pages run 37500261666 passed. Live version.json and public truck-routing.js report FINAL.29.
rootCause: FINAL.28 field evidence showed the route summary itself said 高速・有料区間なし, so the remaining all-blue symptom was not a paint/cache defect.
The production relay requested only ORS waycategory even though ORS exposes dedicated tollways extra information separately.
The missing dedicated tollways source could cause a route to appear unclassified to the client even when provider toll-road metadata exists.
scope: ORS HGV route requests now ask for both waycategory and tollways extras.
The relay validates and forwards dedicated tollways spans.
Route segmentation merges waycategory Highway/Tollways bits with tollways=1 evidence edge-by-edge, even when span boundaries differ.
Any motorway/tollway evidence renders red; ordinary spans remain blue.
waytype=1 is not used as a red fallback because it also includes primary/trunk roads and would create false positives.
FINAL.28 asset-version matching and FINAL.27 fullscreen PIN/detail behavior remain preserved.
Analytics engine, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits, HGV profile and user data remain unchanged.
